assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: publication-bound editorial illustration for a technology news article about Reflection Beam open-weight AI.
Primary request: A tactile, abstract sculptural composition of navy modular computing blocks surrounding one illuminated ivory central block, evoking selective activation and openness as an editorial metaphor, not a technical diagram.
Style/medium: hand-cut paper collage with gouache pigment, subtle three-dimensional maquette depth, visible paper fibers and gently imperfect edges, polished editorial art.
Composition/framing: full-bleed 16:9 landscape, 2048 by 1152 pixels if possible. Central illuminated block and nearby navy modules contained safely in the middle half of the frame for square and 16:10 cropping. Use varied cube heights and a deliberate opening into the arrangement; no circuit diagram or network connections. Wide quiet ivory and stone ground extends beyond the sculpture to all frame edges, no border.
Lighting/mood: soft angled studio light, tactile shadows, calm thoughtful discovery.
Color palette: deep navy, slate, ivory, warm stone with one restrained burgundy module accent.
Constraints: clearly conceptual AI-created artwork, not a photograph of a real system or event. No letters, numbers, logos, charts, arrows, plots, watermarks, readable markings, people, faces, or actual branded product. No text anywhere.

Preserve: tactile paper collage plus gouache and subtle 3D maquette style, navy/ivory/slate/stone/burgundy palette, modest unbranded everyday hatchback shape, blank simple charging post, connected cable, lighting, background artistic theme.
